parental_testing_statement.value: Mutation origin: From mother (Table 1). The mutation co-segregated with disease phenotype in the family (Fig. 2A and B); Sanger sequencing of P1 and family members (Fig. 2B).

functional_evidence_statement.value: Alters the canonical donor splice site downstream of exon 4; regsnp-splicing and HSF predicted 'disease-causing'. Sanger sequencing of P1's blood cDNA identified a mutant allele with an intron 4 insertion containing a premature stop codon resulting in p.D212Gfs*38 (Fig. 2C). RNA sequencing of P1's whole blood showed activation of NF-kB, Toll-like receptor and TNF signalling and a strong type I IFN signature (28-gene IFN score); qPCR confirmed up-regulation of IFN-stimulated genes (IFIT1, IFI44L, RSAD2, ISG15, OAS1, MX2); serum IL-6 elevated.

functional_evidence_statement.value: WES-based CNV analysis identified a heterozygous deletion of exons 7 and 8; qPCR showed decreased relative TNFAIP3 signal with primers targeting exons 7 and 8 in P2 (Fig. 3B). Predicted to remove the OTU domain proximal to the zinc finger domains and zinc finger domains 1–5 (truncation); serum IL-6 elevated.
